body: `maintained_medium_variant_reaches_reproduction_window` is presented as a reproduction guardrail, but it is not actually baselining current scenario behavior: it manually boosts periphyton, adult reserve, and reproductive readiness, then disables shrimp mortality entirely (`crates/tank_harness/tests/e2e_baseline_scenarios.rs:849-858`). That means the test can still pass after regressions in the real survival/stress model, because adults are prevented from dying and start with artificial hidden-state headroom. If reproduction needs its own envelope, it should be a named scenario/fixture built from public startup parameters with normal mortality semantics left on.
